career.lengthSource: TSL/CCRC official 2020 FF1600 result sheets (Circuit Length = 1.8500 miles) | https://www.tsl-timing.com/file/?f=CCRC/2020/202768cf6.pdf
career.layoutCall: Full circuit with the two 1999 chicanes, Bobbies and the Esses (2.977 km): CCRC Formula Ford 1600, July and August 2020. Resurfaced 2015 and partly 2018, surface only; corner renames since 2020 (Hammerdown to Howard's Way, Tower to Gooch's) are names only (research notes item 4). OSM loop through both chicane ways, 'Bobbies' and 'The Esses'.
